probe_fix: Scalar memory cases no longer perform an unrelated 32-byte vector load before the tested four-byte instruction.
scope: Integrated Linux x86-64 translated mode, CPU-only data mapping above the 40-bit GPU range.
known_limits: A plain non-reciprocal read from PROT_NONE below the 40-bit GPU limit reproduces ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory with translation both enabled and disabled. This is separate from reciprocal translation and is not fixed by moving the test.
Explicitly unmapping the high CPU-only allocation causes excessive GPU page-table registration in this baseline. The probe retains its 32 KiB until process exit.
Gameplay and performance comparison remain pending.
